rank_math_desc: 3 day Sossusvlei tour from Windhoek: 2 nights at a desert lodge, Deadvlei, Dune 45 or Big Daddy and park fees included. From USD 1,800 per adult.
post_content: This 3 day Sossusvlei tour from Windhoek spends 2 nights at a Namib Desert lodge with a guided day at Sossusvlei, Deadvlei and the high red dunes of Namib-Naukluft National Park.
overview:
This 3 day Sossusvlei tour from Windhoek is a short guided escape into the Namib Desert, with 2 nights at Hammerstein Lodge or a similar desert lodge on dinner, bed and breakfast. A full day in Namib-Naukluft National Park covers Sossusvlei, Deadvlei and a dune climb such as Dune 45 or Big Daddy. The price starts from USD 1,800 per adult, and it suits couples, photographers and travellers short on time.

The tour works as a stand-alone desert break or as an add-on to a longer Namibia itinerary, with return transfers from Windhoek, a professional English-speaking guide and park entrance fees included.

Why choose a 3 day Sossusvlei tour from Windhoek?

Sossusvlei is a clay pan ringed by some of the highest sand dunes in the world, and neighbouring Deadvlei is famous for its ancient camelthorn trees standing on white clay. Both lie inside Namib-Naukluft National Park, south-west of Windhoek, and they are Namibia's most photographed landscapes.

Two nights near the dunes let you enter the park early, when the low light turns the sand orange and red, instead of rushing there and back in one long day.

  • Photographers: early morning light on the dunes and the white pan of Deadvlei.
  • Short stays: the full Sossusvlei experience in 3 days from Windhoek.
  • Add-on travellers: it can end in Windhoek or continue to your next Namibian destination.

What to expect on the 3 day Sossusvlei tour from Windhoek

Day 1 starts with a meeting by your Divulge Adventures representative and a scenic drive south-west from Windhoek into the Namib Desert. You check in at Hammerstein Lodge or similar and relax. An optional afternoon safari at We Kebi Safari Lodge offers a guided nature drive on private desert land, looking for desert-adapted wildlife at sunset. Dinner and overnight at the lodge.

Day 2 is an early start into Namib-Naukluft National Park. You explore Sossusvlei and walk across the white clay pan of Deadvlei, then climb a famous dune such as Dune 45 or Big Daddy for wide views. After time for walking and photography, you return to the lodge in the afternoon for dinner under the desert stars.

Day 3 begins with breakfast and, depending on your departure time, a short nature walk around the lodge. After check-out you drive back to Windhoek or continue to your next stop in Namibia.

When is the best time for a Sossusvlei tour?

Sossusvlei can be visited all year, and the trip page does not set a season. The cooler months, roughly May to September, make dune climbs more comfortable, while December to February is hot by midday, so early starts matter even more then. Read our best time to visit Namibia guide for month-by-month conditions, and our Namibia photography tour guide for tips on shooting the dunes.

What is included in this Namib Desert tour?

The price includes 2 nights of accommodation, daily breakfast and dinner at the lodge, return transfers from Windhoek or your start point (shared or private, as booked), the guided excursion to Sossusvlei and Deadvlei, Namib-Naukluft National Park entrance fees, a professional English-speaking guide and driver, an air-conditioned vehicle or 4x4 depending on group size, bottled water during touring and all sightseeing on the itinerary.

Not included are international and domestic flights, travel insurance, visa fees, personal expenses such as tips, laundry, drinks and souvenirs, and optional activities: the We Kebi Safari Lodge afternoon safari, hot air ballooning over Sossusvlei and scenic flights. To see why a guide makes desert travel easier, read why choose a guided Namibia safari, or add Etosha on the 5 day Sossusvlei and Etosha tour.

faq.q: When is the best time for the 3 day Sossusvlei tour from Windhoek?
faq.a: The 3 day Sossusvlei tour from Windhoek runs all year. The cooler months, roughly May to September, are the most comfortable for climbing dunes, while December to February is hot by midday. In every season the tour enters Namib-Naukluft National Park early, when the light on the dunes is best and temperatures are lower.

faq.q: What is included in the 3 day Sossusvlei tour from Windhoek?
faq.a: The Sossusvlei tour includes 2 nights of accommodation with breakfast and dinner, return transfers from Windhoek, the guided Sossusvlei and Deadvlei excursion, Namib-Naukluft National Park fees, an English-speaking guide, an air-conditioned vehicle or 4x4 and bottled water. Flights, insurance, visas, tips, drinks and optional activities such as ballooning are extra.

faq.q: Where do you stay on this Sossusvlei tour?
faq.a: On this Sossusvlei tour you stay 2 nights at Hammerstein Lodge or a similar quality desert lodge, on a dinner, bed and breakfast basis. We confirm the lodge in your written quote based on availability for your dates. An optional afternoon safari at We Kebi Safari Lodge can be added on the first day.

faq.q: Is the 3 day Sossusvlei tour suitable for families and older travellers?
faq.a: Yes, the 3 day Sossusvlei tour suits most ages because the dune climb is optional. The walk to Deadvlei crosses soft sand, so bring good shoes, a hat and plenty of water. Tell us the ages of your group and we will plan a pace that suits everyone.
